xpath.div: LinkedIn did not grant this account the permission the import of its history needs (), so it refuses to serve its publications. Enable the matching product on the LinkedIn application, then press Update account with Update keys checked to authorize this account again: refreshing the token alone keeps the scopes it already has.

button.name: action_full_resync
button.invisible: media_type != 'linkedin' or not can_manage_account or not active
button.confirm: The whole feed of the page will be read again, which costs one call per hundred publications against the daily quota of LinkedIn. Continue?
button.title: Read the whole feed again and mark as deleted what is no longer on LinkedIn. This is the only action that notices the publications deleted there, and the scheduled action already does it weekly on its own.
